name: Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the agricultural and animal husbandry businesses in China and internationally. It operates through five segments: Aquaculture Industry; Engineering and Equipment Manufacturing; Meat Processing; Animal Health Industry; and Other Industries. The company breeds, farms, and sells livestock and poultry, including chickens, pigs, ducks, geese, pigeons, waterfowls, laying hens, and other breeds. It also offers room and low temperature dairy products; poultry and livestock products; chicken, pork, fresh eggs and related products, cooked food, and raw milk under the Wens brand name.
